1. Definitions.

"Adopter" means an individual or entity that has agreed to the terms of this
Agreement.

"FIT Protocol" means the Flexible and Interoperable Data Transfer protocol,
including the file format, message definitions, and accompanying software
development kit (SDK), object code, source code, documentation, and sample code
made available by Garmin.

"Garmin" means Garmin International, Inc. and its affiliates.

"FIT Products" means products developed by an Adopter that implement the FIT
Protocol.
